title: Organizing Director
body_text:
Don Davis for NC is seeking an Organizing Director to implement and lead organizing 
operations in accordance with the campaign’s mission, values, and strategic plan within NC-01. 
The Organizing Director will work under the day-to–day supervision of the Campaign Manager, 
and the Candidate and Senior Advisor more broadly. The Organizing Director will directly 
manage Regional Organizers and the broader field organizing team. This is a senior-level, 
full-time position running from June 2026, through November 2026. Ties to NC and eNC are a 
plus, but not required. Compensation will be commensurate with experience, but will be 
competitive for a frontline organizing director.  

Responsibilities 

●  Work with the Campaign Manager to execute, and manage district-wide field strategy 

with a particular focus on the Elizabeth City, NC headquarters location.  

●  Recruit, hire, train, and manage Regional Organizers, volunteers, and paid field 

operations. 

●  Set clear weekly, monthly, and district-wide goals and ensure staff consistently meet 

performance benchmarks. 

●  Build and oversee systems of accountability, performance tracking, and reporting for 

staff and volunteers. 

●  Analyze voter data, modeling, and turnout goals to create, refine, and track voter contact 

universes. 

●  Coordinate closely with partner campaigns, candidates, county parties, and allied 

organizations to maximize efforts. 

●  Provide regular reports on field performance, staffing, voter contact, and progress toward 

goals to the Campaign Manager, Candidate, and Senior Advisor. 
●  Support and troubleshoot challenges faced by district-based field staff. 
●  Staff assorted events within the district including weekly canvasses/phonebanks, 

meet-and-greets, and miscellaneous tasks as needed.  

Qualifications 

●  3+ cycles of electoral campaign organizing required  
●  At least 1 cycle of staff management experience preferred  
●  Ability to live and work in-person within the assigned congressional district through 

November 2026  

●  Proficiency in VAN or PDI, Google Docs, and Mobilize 
●  Valid driver’s license with a clean record and access to a vehicle is required  
●  Ability to work long hours, including evenings and weekends 
●  Familiarity with peer-to-peer texting, relational, and dialer tools  
●  Experience developing, training, and empowering volunteers  
●  Ability to meet tight deadlines under pressure and problem solve effectively and 

creatively  

●  Proven interpersonal, communication, and collaboration skills with the ability to build 

relationships with staff, stakeholders, and volunteers at all levels  

 
 
 
 
 
 Equal Opportunity/Diversity Policy:  
DCCC prohibits discrimination of employment, promotion, compensation, terms, conditions, or 
privileges of employment on the basis of race, color, ancestry, national origin, gender, sexual 
orientation, sex (including marital and parental status), religion, age, disability, actual or 
perceived gender identity or expression, weight, personal appearance, family responsibilities, 
genetic information, economic status, genetic information, veteran’s status, or any other basis 
prohibited by applicable law. DCCC is an equal opportunity employer and will comply with all 
applicable laws prohibiting discrimination in employment.  

Interested individuals should send a resume and cover letter detailing past experience to 
Hannah Spengler at hannah@votedondavis.com. Please include your last name and 
“Organizing Director” in the subject line. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis.

title: Driver/Aide
body_text:
Driver/Aide 

Location: Wilmington, DE 

McBride for Delaware seeks a Driver/Aide to support the candidate in the day-to-day 

operations of the campaign. The Driver/Aide will work across departments to staff the 

candidate during all events. When the candidate does not require staffing, the assistant will 

be embedded within the communications department, helping to amplify the campaign’s 

message online by planning and producing content. This position reports to the Campaign 

Manager. 

Job Duties: 

●  Staffing the Candidate (70%) 

○  The campaign assistant will organize and manage the candidate’s travel 

arrangements across the state while staffing all external meetings and events 

on the calendar. 

○  Organize prep materials for the candidate’s engagements.  

○  Closely review the candidate’s schedule, planning transportation needs and 

anticipating complications, iterating systems to bolster the campaign’s 

operations.  

○  Ensure the candidate remains on schedule throughout the day. 

○  Report any relevant information to departments across the campaign for 

follow-up. 

○  Other duties as assigned. As campaigns are necessarily dynamic 

organizations, duties may shift, perhaps even significantly. 

●  Supporting Communications Department (30%) 

○  When not staffing the candidate, the campaign assistant will assist the 

communications department with: 

■  Monitoring and managing campaign email inboxes, responding to 

general inquiries and triaging incoming messages. 

■  Assisting with content creation, including writing copy, pulling assets, 

and coordinating with designers or vendors. 

■  Supporting day-to-day social media operations, including content 

organization, posting, and basic community management. 

 
 
 
 
 ■  Tracking digital performance metrics (email, social, SMS) and compiling 

reports to inform strategy. 

■  Supporting website updates and digital content management as 

needed. 

Qualifications: 

●  Access to a cell phone, laptop, valid driver’s license, and car. 

●  Social media experience preferred. 

●  Exemplary time management skills, comfortable in a fast-paced, continuously 

evolving environment with multiple tasks and competing deadlines. 

●  Calm in challenging situations. 

●  Able to communicate information essential to performance directly and forthrightly. 

●  Experience working in NGP and proficiency in excel and Google Sheets is preferred. 

Compensation: $3,800/m - $4,200/m commensurate with experience. Compensation 

includes comprehensive health care coverage (including vision and dental). 

We recognize that women, people of color, and other marginalized groups are less likely to 

apply for a position if they don’t fit every criteria. If you think you’d be a good fit for this 

position, please apply anyway. We’d love to hear from you. 

To apply, please send your resume with the subject line “Driver/Aide” to 

connor@sarahmcbride.com. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis until filled. Start 

date ASAP. 

McBride for Delaware, Inc is an inclusive, welcoming, and diverse campaign. We are an equal 

opportunity employer committed to understanding and creating a culture that allows us to 

better serve our employees, and the communities we work with. All qualified applicants will 

receive consideration without regard to race, national origin, age, sex, religion, disability, 

sexual orientation, marital status, veteran status, gender identity or expression, or any other 

basis protected by local, state, or federal law. This policy applies with regard to all aspects of 

one’s employment and fellowship, including hiring, transfer, promotion, compensation, 

eligibility for benefits, and termination.

title: Senior Campaign Political Director
body_text:
The campaign of Congresswoman Leger Fernandez (NM-3) seeks a highly motivated Senior 
Campaign Political Director located in Santa Fe, New Mexico.  This position will directly report 
to the Congresswoman and work on 1) the Congresswoman’s 2026 campaign and 2) potential 
long-term projects associated with New Mexico’s position as the 4th state in the 2028 
Presidential Primary.  Job responsibilities associated with the 2026 campaign include leading the 
social media and communications strategy, political director responsibilities, managing 
volunteers, working with the campaign manager and consultant team, and other duties as needed. 
Long term, this position will spearhead building and maintaining the Congresswoman's political 
operation.  The Congresswoman is the Chairwoman of the Democratic Women’s Caucus. Health 
care benefits included and salary commensurate with experience. 

To apply, please send a cover letter and resume in one attachment to 
Nathan.Schelble@gmail.com.

title: Field Director
body_text:
Field Director: Grace for New York  

Role Description: The Field Director will be responsible for designing and executing a 
comprehensive strategy for voter persuasion, mobilization, and engagement. They will manage a 
team of field organizers, interns, and volunteers – monitoring progress, conducting training, and 
directing daily operations.  

Core Responsibilities:  

●  Develop and implement a field plan that provides clear benchmarks for recruitment and 

voter contacts. 

●  Hire and train a team of field organizers in critical skill areas. 
●  Oversee daily operations, including volunteer recruitment, phonebanks, canvass launches, 

turf cutting, visibility, and other key activities. 

●  Manage the campaign’s voter contact and volunteer data and records. 
●  Communicate regularly with the Campaign Manager to report daily results and 

troubleshoot challenges.  

Qualifications: 

●  Minimum 1-2 years experience in field organizing or other relevant campaign work. 
●  Strong familiarity with voter contact platforms (VAN, Mobilize, etc.) and ability to train 

staff. 

●  Strong organizational skills and a talent for multitasking. 
●  Ability to work from the Flushing, Queens campaign office and maintain flexible 

working hours. Access to a car is required.  

●  Multilingual skills are a plus.  

To apply, please email your professional resume to Harry@gracefornewyork.com with the 
subject line “Field Director, [LAST NAME].” 

Salary Range: $5,500 - $7,500 a month, commensurate with experience.  

Grace for New York is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, 
national origin, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, or any other status protected by federal law.

title: Organizing Director
body_text:

program and empowering a network of volunteers, staff, and partners to execute

program. 

●  Build relationships with local stakeholders and leaders to develop a long-lasting

title: Regional Field Director
body_text:
Regional Field Director 

Location: Sussex County, DE (supporter housing may be available, but is not guaranteed) 

McBride for Delaware seeks a Regional Field Director to lead organizing in Sussex County, 

Delaware, part of Delaware’s at-large congressional district. This is an exciting opportunity for 

an experienced organizer to help drive a core part of the re-elect strategy by persuading 

voters and building infrastructure in a historically conservative county. The Regional Field 

Director will play a key role in building and sustaining a strong direct voter contact program, 

with a focus on canvassing, phone banking, and volunteer engagement. This position reports 

to the Campaign Manager. 

Job Duties: 

●  Design and execute a direct voter contact program specific to Sussex County, 

including canvassing, phone banking, and text outreach. 

●  Build and maintain relationships with grassroots and community leaders, including 

the field department of the coordinated campaign. 

●  Recruit, train, and manage volunteers to support persuasion and GOTV efforts. 

● 

Lead volunteer shifts and ensure strong data collection and reporting through VAN. 

●  Track what’s working and what we’re hearing from voters and report that back to the 

campaign with succinct and strategic reports using both quantitative (e.g., key 

metrics) and qualitative information. 

●  Plan and execute events and organize activities, including rallies and 

meet-and-greets. 

●  Support digital organizing efforts, including peer-to-peer texting and virtual 

engagement. 

●  Meet and exceed weekly and monthly voter contact and volunteer recruitment goals. 

●  Other duties as assigned. As campaigns are necessarily dynamic organizations, 

duties may shift, perhaps even significantly. 

Qualifications: 

●  At least one cycle of campaign experience or equivalent organizing experience 

preferred. 

●  An ability to work independently, as this position is likely the only Field operative for the 

campaign in Sussex County. 

 
 
 
 
 
 ●  Strong interpersonal skills and ability to motivate volunteers. 

●  Familiarity with VAN and other organizing tools. 

●  A high degree of emotional intelligence and a genuine excitement for direct voter 

contact. 

●  Strong written and verbal communication skills. 

●  Must be willing and able to relocate to Sussex County, DE.  

Compensation: $4,100/m – $4,500/m commensurate with experience. This is an exempt, 

full-time position. Compensation will include comprehensive health care coverage (including

title: Finance Director/Deputy Finance Director
body_text:
Nikki for Congress is seeking a strategic and detail-oriented Finance Director or Deputy 
Finance Director. This individual will be responsible for the development and execution of a 
robust fundraising program to ensure the campaign has the resources necessary for victory and 
long-term sustainability. This is a permanent position and will continue on from the general 
election. 

Primary Responsibilities 

●  Fundraising Strategy: Develop and execute a comprehensive finance plan with 

ambitious fundraising goals across national and in-state channels. 

●  Management: Directly supervise and develop the Call-Time Manager; oversee the 

execution of the thank-you note process and daily call-time operations. 

●  Consultant Liaison: Serve as the primary campaign point of contact for national 

fundraising, digital, and PAC consultants. 

●  Events & Travel: Lead the planning and execution of in-state and national fundraising 
events; support the candidate during national fundraising travel (approx. 10–15%). 

●  Data: Manage the donor database (NGP) to ensure meticulous record-keeping 
●  Budgeting: Reports to the Campaign Manager to support budget reconciliation..  
●  Partnerships: Cultivate and maintain relationships with national, state, & district donors 

and partners 

Qualifications 

●  Experience and Skillset: A proven track record in political fundraising, campaign 

finance, or high-level development. The depth of the candidate's professional skillset and 
historical performance will determine whether they are hired as a Director or Deputy 
Director. 

●  Competitive Background: Experience on a highly competitive congressional race is 

strongly preferred. 

●  Technical Proficiency: Mastery of NGP/VAN and the Google Suite (Docs, Sheets, 
Slides) is required. Familiarity with ActBlue and digital/SMS fundraising platforms. 

●  Compliance: Strong working knowledge of FEC regulations and campaign finance law; 

experience working alongside a professional compliance firm. 

●  Communication: Exceptional verbal and written skills; comfort engaging with major 

donors, elected officials, and stakeholders. 

●  Leadership: Demonstrated ability to manage staff or interns and a commitment to their 

professional development. 

●  Logistics: Must be willing to reside in Illinois and travel as needed for national 

fundraising efforts. Illinois ties appreciated, but not required. 

 
 
 
 
 Compensation and Benefits 

Compensation is competitive and based on experience. The campaign provides 3 weeks paid 
vacation per year, and full coverage for health, dental, and vision benefits at no cost to staff. 

Application requirements 

Please send the following materials to jim@nikkiforcongress.com: 

●  Resume 
●  Cover Letter 
●  Three References

title: Digital Director
body_text:
JOB POSTING: DIGITAL DIRECTOR 

Jason Crow (D-CO) seeks a full-time Digital Director to lead digital strategy for his political 
campaign and his work boosting Democrats nationwide. This role will be on the frontlines of 
advancing Democrats’ message in 2026 and beyond, while advancing the Congressman’s profile 
in Colorado and nationally. 

Responsibilities: 

●  Pitching, drafting, and posting engaging digital content, tailored to the Congressman’s 

political accounts and his national leadership; 

●  Designing, filming, and editing clean and captivating video content; 
●  Searching for unique opportunities to engage online through media monitoring, digital 

analytics, and new trends; 

●  Managing and updating the Congressman’s campaign branding and website; 
●  Producing original graphics in line with campaign branding; 
●  Coordinating with political, finance, and operations staff to plan communications 
strategies around endorsements, campaign events, major deadlines, and more; 
●  Collaborating with endorsed candidates, campaign committees, and stakeholder 
organizations to support Democratic messaging and boost fellow Democrats and 
Democratic-aligned groups locally and nationally; 

●  Building new media relationships around the country, especially through the 

Congressman’s leadership as a DCCC Recruitment Co-Chair; 

●  Supporting traditional press needs, including quote drafts, press release drafts, and the 

maintenance of press lists. 

Qualifications: 

●  Creativity and pro-activeness to help build the Congressman’s political brand online 

using digital, video, and new media opportunities; 
●  Skills with advanced photo and video editing programs; 
●  Past experience with political campaigns or equivalent experience with a political, 

organizing, elected office, electoral, or issue organization; 

●  Excellent organizational abilities and writing skills, including ability to create and build 

effective tracking systems, while balancing multiple priorities at once; 

●  Self-starter, with strong written and verbal communication skills and strict attention to 

detail, and a demonstrated ability to meet goals while working on a deadline; 

●  Must be willing to travel, staff events on nights and weekends as needed, and be part of a 

campaign on the front lines of resisting harmful Trump Administration policies. 

 
  
 
 
 
 Hours and Compensation: 

This is a full-time position, based in either Colorado or Washington, D.C., that extends beyond 
the November 2026 election. Candidates will be required to work nights and weekends as 
needed, and travel for work with the Congressman in Colorado and nationally. The salary for this 
position will be $6,000-8,000 per month, in addition to benefits, including health care, vision, 
and dental insurance, and paid leave. The Digital Director will work regularly with the 
Congressman, report to the Communications Director, and collaborate with other members of the 
Congressman’s senior political team. 

How to Apply: 

Interested candidates should submit a resume, cover letter, and digital portfolio to 
jobs@jasoncrowforcongress.com and list “Digital Director” in the subject line. Applications will 
be considered on a rolling basis.

title: Finance Assistant
body_text:
Finance Assistant for Congresswoman Emilia Sykes for Congress  

The Emilia Sykes for Campaign campaign is hiring a full-time Finance Assistant for the 2026 
election. This position will be responsible for supporting the fundraising efforts for one of the 
most competitive congressional races in the country.  

This position is full-time, in-person, and based in Akron, Ohio. Non-local applicants must be 
willing to relocate.  

Salary: $4,000 per month, including employer-sponsored health insurance. 

Job Responsibilities  

Fundraising Management  

●  Work directly with the Finance Director to execute the campaign finance plan and ensure 

accurate data entry. 

●  Collaborate with in-state and national partner organizations to support fundraising efforts.  
●  Use ActBlue, NGP, Democracy Engine, Calltime.ai and other fundraising management 

platforms to maintain detailed records and ensure data integrity. 

●  Assist with campaign finance compliance processes: processing checks, in-kind 

contribution forms, campaign receipts, and reimbursement forms.  

●  Other duties as assigned by the campaign. 

Donor Engagement  

●  Cultivate relationships with existing donors and prospects.  
●  Collaborate with Campaign Manager and Finance Director to design and execute 
high-dollar donor engagement program including all events and communications. 
Recruit district event hosts for fundraisers.  

●  Track major donor outreach and manage a donor acknowledgement process (thank you 

calls, emails, notes).  

Call Time  

●  Manage the successful strategy and implementation of the call time program. 
●  Prepare lists and staff candidate call time, including running the call time software 

and taking detailed notes.  

●  Manage follow up to donors, including timely emails and phone calls.  
●  Execute your own call time to donors to provide updates on campaign and ask for their 

support.  

 
 
 
 
 
 Candidate and Campaign support  

●  Staff candidate for fundraising events and meetings.  
●  Staff candidate for additional campaign events as needed.  
●  Drive candidate to events.  
●  Provide ad-hoc support to the candidate and the campaign as needed.  

Qualifications/Skills:  

●  Openness and excitement about working with donors and volunteers.  
●  Organizational skills &  strong attention to detail.  
●  Professionalism.  
●  Strong written, verbal, and interpersonal communications skills.  
●  Willingness to travel in-state as needed 
●  Valid driver’s licence and access to reliable transportation. 
●  Willingness to work campaign hours, which can be long, irregular, and include 

nights/weekends as needed, particularly as the general election campaign ramps up. 

This role does not require prior campaign experience or a college degree. We are willing to train 
the right person to succeed in this role. Campaigns are ‘all hands on deck’ and you may 
frequently be asked to complete tasks that are not included in your job description.  

This position will run for the duration of the 2026 election cycle, concluding November of 2026. 

To Apply 

Please submit a resume and three professional references to 
shakiyla@emiliasykesforcongress.com with the subject line “YOUR NAME - Finance Assistant 
Application”

title: Area Field Organizer
body_text:
Area Field Organizer for Emilia Sykes for Congress 

Region: Northern Summit County, Akron, and Portage County 
The Emilia Sykes for Congress campaign is hiring a full-time (40-hours/week) Area Field Organizer for 
the 2026 election. This is a key field position within the campaign responsible for executing an ambitious 
voter contact plan and building a strong volunteer base in one of the most competitive congressional 
districts in the country. The Area Field Organizer will report directly to the Director of Outreach and 
Organizing. This position is full-time, in-person, and based in Northern Summit County, Akron, and 
Portage County. Non-local applicants must be willing to relocate. The schedule will vary based on the 
needs of the campaign, including evenings and weekends throughout the election cycle. 

Salary: $5,000 per month, including employer sponsored health insurance. 

Responsibilities:  
The Area Field Organizer is responsible for executing the campaign’s direct voter contact program across 
Northern Summit County, Akron, and Portage County. This role will focus on building relationships with 
voters, recruiting and managing volunteers, and meeting weekly voter contact goals through a 
combination of canvassing, phone banking, and community-based outreach. 

The Area Field Organizer will serve as the campaign’s primary presence in their assigned region, ensuring 
consistent voter engagement while supporting local partnerships and maintaining strong ties with 
community organizations. Willingness to work campaign hours, which can be long, irregular, and include 
nights/weekends regularly, particularly as the general election campaign ramps up. This also includes the 
following and other duties as assigned, not limited to:  

Key Responsibilities 
Direct Voter Contact and Field Execution 

●  Conduct and lead door to door canvassing and phone banking efforts Meet and exceed weekly 

voter contact goals through direct outreach. 

●  Utilize VoteBuilder, MiniVAN and Mobilize to track doors knocked, update voter data and    

volunteers. 

Volunteer Recruitment and Management 

●  Recruit, train, and support volunteers to participate in voter outreach efforts. 
●  Lead weekly canvass launches and phone banking events. 
●  Build and maintain a reliable volunteer base within the assigned area. 

Area Organizing and Community Engagement 

●  Develop relationships with local leaders, organizations, and community stakeholders. 
●  Attend community meetings, events, and organizational gatherings to represent the campaign. 
●  Coordinate outreach efforts with local partners to expand voter engagement. 
●  Administrative and Reporting Responsibilities. 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 ●  Manage turf assignments and ensure accurate data entry in the voter file. 
●  Track and report daily and weekly voter contact metrics. 
●  Maintain consistent communication with the Director of Outreach and Organizing regarding 

progress and challenges. 

●  Support campaign logistics including materials preparation and event coordination. 
●  Other duties as assigned. 

Qualifications 

●  Strong communication and interpersonal skills. 
●  Ability to work independently and manage time effectively. 
●  Willingness to work evenings and weekends. 
●  Adaptable and able to work in a fast paced campaign environment. 
●  Strong organizational and time management skills. 
●  Passionate about civic engagement, voter outreach and working with volunteers. 
●  Demonstrated commitment to electing Democratic candidates. 
●  Experience in field organizing, canvassing, or community engagement preferred. 
●  Familiarity with voter databases such as Votebuilder, Mobilize is a plus. 
●  Valid driver’s license and vehicle. 

To Apply:  
Please submit a resume and three references to nj@emiliasykesforcongress.com with the subject line 
“YOUR NAME - Area Field Organizer Application”.

title: Finance Director
body_text:
Stanton For Congress Finance Director

Job Description

Stanton for Congress seeks a self-starting, creative, and highly organized individual to serve as Finance Director. This is a senior role for someone ready to take real ownership of a congressional finance operation, serve as a key advisor to campaign leadership, and be part of every major strategic decision.

The Finance Director will help drive the resources, relationships, and planning behind a serious political operation in Arizona, one of the most important states in Democratic politics. This is an opportunity for someone who wants responsibility, access, and growth, not just another campaign job.

Job Duties
Create, oversee, and execute the campaign’s finance plan, including fundraising goals, timelines, projections, and progress-to-goal tracking
Develop and manage fundraising strategy in coordination with campaign leadership, consultants, and the candidate
Serve as a key senior advisor on campaign strategy, budget, donor engagement, and major finance decisions
Cultivate, build, and sustain relationships with donors, supporters, PACs, labor, stakeholders, and national and Arizona political networks
Manage the campaign’s finance team, including staff, consultants, vendors, interns, and event support as needed
Prepare the candidate and senior team for call time, donor meetings, fundraising events, and finance committee engagement
Oversee a portfolio of in-state and national fundraising events, including in-person and virtual events
Work with the campaign finance team and event hosts to plan, execute, and follow up on fundraising events
Coordinate event logistics and scheduling operations with official team
Track donor pipelines, outstanding pledges, event performance, and key finance projects
Produce regular finance reports for campaign leadership, including cash flow, fundraising projections, and progress toward goals
Support compliance, reporting, contribution processing, and database management
Other duties as assigned

Skills and Qualifications
Two or more cycles of relevant campaign finance experience
Strong written and verbal communication skills
Proficiency with NGP VAN, ActBlue, Warchest, and other fundraising and compliance tools
Familiarity with federal campaign finance rules and FEC compliance processes
Experience managing finance staff, consultants, vendors, interns, or event support
Experience working directly with candidates, principals, donors, and high-level stakeholders
Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail
Expectations: 
Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced campaign environment
Ability to manage strict event, finance, compliance, and reporting deadlines
Sound judgment, discretion, and professionalism in handling sensitive donor and campaign information
Ability to work respectfully, effectively, and tactfully with donors, supporters, staff, vendors, and members of the public
Willingness to work campaign hours, including evenings and weekends as needed
Commitment to the values and ideals of the Democratic Party
Compensation and Benefits
Salary for this position is $7,500 to $8,500 per month, paid monthly, based on experience.
Stanton for Congress also provides:
A $400 monthly healthcare stipend
Relocation assistance for candidates moving to Phoenix
Opportunities for professional growth and senior-level experience on a high-profile congressional campaign in one of the country’s most competitive political environments
Job Requirements
This is a full-time, campaign-cycle position based in Phoenix, Arizona. The Finance Director is expected to work in person and serve as a senior member of the campaign team. Candidates must be able to relocate to Phoenix for the duration of the campaign. Some in-state and national travel may be required.
Preferred start date is May/June  2026. Applications will be accepted until the position is filled.
To Apply
Priority Consideration Deadline:  Friday, May 15, 2026
Application Deadline:  May 26, 2026
Please apply directly through Indeed or send resume and 3 references to Cameron at cameron@stantonforarizona.com with the subject line “Finance Director”:  https://www.indeed.com/job/stanton-congress-finance-director-b1394c622248777e
Equal Opportunity Statement
Stanton for Congress is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, veteran status, marital or parental status, pregnancy, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.
We strongly encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, including women, people of color, LGBTQ+ people, people with disabilities, veterans, first-generation professionals, and those from communities historically underrepresented in campaign politics.

title: Call Time Manager
body_text:
Call Time Manager — Job Description 

Stanton For Congress seeks a highly organized and detail-oriented individual to serve as a Call 
Time Manager. This is an exciting opportunity to manage the core fundraising operations for one 
of the top congressional campaigns of 2026, while gaining valuable experience in one of the 
most competitive states in the country. This position can extend past the 2026 election cycle if 
duties are performed well. 

The CTM will work directly with the Congressman to prepare, execute, and follow up on 
fundraising call time, ensuring the campaign meets its financial goals. This position is ideal for 
someone looking to master the fundamentals of campaign fundraising and data management. 

Job Duties 

●  Staff the Congressman during all scheduled call time sessions, ensuring a high-energy, 

efficient environment. 

●  Build, clean, and maintain donor prospect lists to ensure a consistent pipeline of outreach. 
●  Manage high-volume data entry, tracking contributions, pledges, and call outcomes 

accurately in the campaign database. 

●  Conduct research to prepare comprehensive briefing materials  
●  Manage the prompt follow-up of all pledges, invoices, and donor correspondence resulting 

from call time. 

●  Assist senior finance staff with database management and compliance reporting. 
●  Assist with other administrative and fundraising tasks as needed. 

Essential Skills & Requirements 

●  Excellent oral and written communication skills. 
●  Exceptional organizational skills and meticulous attention to detail. 
●  Ability to work efficiently in a fast-paced environment and handle repetitive tasks with a high 

degree of accuracy. 

●  Ability to exercise discretion and maintain strict confidentiality regarding donor data and 

candidate interactions. 

 
 
 ●  Proficiency with campaign databases (e.g., NGP VAN) and donor management software 

(e.g., Numero) is highly preferred. 

●  Commitment to the values and ideals of the Democratic Party. 

●  Willingness to work flexible hours including evenings and weekends as campaign demands 

require 

Compensation and Benefits 

Salary for this position is $4,500 to $5,500 per month, paid monthly, based on experience. 

Stanton for Congress also provides: 

●  A $400 monthly healthcare stipend 
●  Relocation assistance for candidates moving to Phoenix 
●  Opportunities for professional growth and senior-level experience on a high-proﬁle 

congressional campaign in one of the country’s most competitive political environments 

Job Requirements 

This is a permanent, full-time, and at-will position. Prior campaign experience or internships, 
particularly in finance, data management, or donor databases, is preferred. This position may if 
desired extend past the 2026 election cycle. 

Location 

Hybrid in Phoenix, Arizona 

To apply, please submit a resume and 2 references to this Indeed posting:  

https://www.indeed.com/job/call-time-manager-6fb6c86cc28ad3bc

title: Campaign Coordinator
body_text:
Campaign Coordinator  

Location: Wilmington, DE 

McBride for Delaware seeks a Campaign Coordinator to manage and execute key 

day-to-day operations for the campaign. The Campaign Coordinator will work across 

departments and assist with political, fundraising, and organizing. Additionally, the Campaign 

Coordinator will lead the coordination and execution for larger campaign events. This 

position reports to the Campaign Manager. 

Job Duties: 

●  Represent the campaign at local Democratic committee meetings, political events, 

and community gatherings to build and maintain strong relationships with party 

leaders, activists, and stakeholders. 

●  Track engagement with local committees and stakeholders, including managing the 

candidate’s political call time and maintaining organized records and reporting key 

insights to senior staff. 

●  Plan and execute campaign events, including coordinating logistics, planning, and 

on-the-ground support. 

●  Engage and coordinate with surrogates and supporters, including identifying local 

validators for campaign events and earned media. 

●  Distribute yard signs as needed. 

●  Support special projects as needed, including cross-departmental initiatives. 

●  Provide general campaign support, helping ensure smooth day-to-day operations 

and contributing to overall campaign goals. 

●  Other duties as assigned. As campaigns are necessarily dynamic organizations, 

duties may shift, perhaps even significantly. 

Qualifications: 

●  Access to a cell phone, laptop, valid driver’s license, and car. 

●  Detail-oriented self-starter with an interest in Democratic politics. 

●  Proven experience managing event logistics and working in political or advocacy 

campaigns. 

●  Exemplary time management skills, comfortable in a fast-paced, continuously 

evolving environment with multiple tasks and competing deadlines. 

 
 
 
 
 
 ●  Calm in challenging situations. 

●  Able to communicate information essential to performance directly and forthrightly. 

●  Experience working in NGP and proficiency in excel and Google Sheets is preferred. 

Compensation: $4,000/m - $4,400/m commensurate with experience. Compensation 

includes comprehensive health care coverage (including vision and dental). 

We recognize that women, people of color, and other marginalized groups are less likely to 

apply for a position if they don’t fit every criteria. If you think you’d be a good fit for this 

position, please apply anyway. We’d love to hear from you. 

To apply, please send your resume with the subject line “Campaign Coordinator” to 

connor@sarahmcbride.com. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis until filled. Start 

date ASAP. 

McBride for Delaware, Inc is an inclusive, welcoming, and diverse campaign. We are an equal 

opportunity employer committed to understanding and creating a culture that allows us to 

better serve our employees, and the communities we work with. All qualified applicants will 

receive consideration without regard to race, national origin, age, sex, religion, disability, 

sexual orientation, marital status, veteran status, gender identity or expression, or any other 

basis protected by local, state, or federal law. This policy applies with regard to all aspects of 

one’s employment and fellowship, including hiring, transfer, promotion, compensation, 

eligibility for benefits, and termination.

title: Field Organizer
body_text:
Congressman Pallone Field Organizer 

Job Title/Role: Field Organizer 

Location: Long Branch/Edison New Jersey  

About the candidate: Frank Pallone Jr. is the Democratic Congressman from New Jersey’s 6th 
District (Middlesex and Monmouth counties). Congressman Pallone serves as the top Democrat on 
the Energy and Commerce Committee and has had an extensive career that includes fervent 
environmental advocacy and pushing for innovative health care policy. After winning the primary this 
June he will be facing a Republican opponent in the November general election.  

Opportunity: We are looking for Field Organizers dedicated to ensuring Central Jersey stays blue. 
Our effort will rely on a strong field program and constant coordination with volunteers and political 
stakeholders. We need Organizers that can assist us in reaching our turnout goal in the upcoming 
election. Prior campaign experience strongly preferred. Ties to the area are favored.  

Contact: If interested email a resume, cover letter, and references to 
Jorge@pallonefornewjersey.com. If we feel it’s a fit, we will reach out to schedule an interview. 

Job Responsibilities:  

●  Regularly working non-traditional hours; Evenings and weekends. To facilitate the daily 

phonebanks at 4:00pm throughout the week with additional times during the afternoon on 
weekends and to attend events and canvasses as scheduled 

●  Recruiting, training, coordinating volunteers for campaign events across their assigned 

region. Utilizing all available methods. 

●  Working with Municipal chairs and other local stakeholders on canvassing events, 

phonebanks, rallies, and other visibility events created for their localities.  

●  Executing daily field events and canvasses reaching voters to gather support ahead of the 

November election

assigned.

Paid: Yes 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Start Date: Rolling Basis(ASAP)

personalities 

●  Strong creative problem solving skills

title: Political Director
body_text:
Job Opportunity: Political Director 

Maggie for Congress is hiring a Political Director, a member of the senior leadership team for 
Congresswoman Maggie Goodlander 2026 re-election campaign. The Political Director will lead

organized labor, and community grassroots leaders.  

Your role will include: 

●  Leading the the team in planning, building, and staffing events around the district with 

the Congresswoman  

●  Building and maintaining relationships with key NH stakeholders, including elected 

officials, organized labor, and community grassroots leaders 
●  Liaising with communications team in building press events 
●  Helping manage team of fellows and volunteers 
●  Coordinating with team to plan the Congresswoman’s in-district schedule 
●  Other duties as assigned 

Ideal experience: 

●  A strong commitment to Democratic values and enthusiasm for electing Maggie 

Goodlander 

●  Ability to work in a fast-paced environment, with short deadlines, and regularly during 

evenings and weekends, depending on the Congresswoman’s schedule 

●  At least 1-2 cycles of campaign experience 
●  Experience working with external stakeholders and community leaders 
●  Experience working with and managing volunteers 
●  Positive attitude, excellent interpersonal skills, and have the ability to work within a team
